named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO web page describing its Digital Competency Framework for civil servants, which builds government capacity on AI and digital transformation based on ROAM-X principles. It lists recommendations, challenges and the SPARK-AI Alliance of public administration schools. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework strengthens civil servants' digital and AI competencies, grounded in ROAM-X principles
Framework is open and context-sensitive, adaptable by governments
Recommends awareness-raising, localisation, resource sharing and multilateral knowledge exchange
Identifies cultural, data/infrastructure and human resource barriers
SPARK-AI Alliance networks 50+ public administration schools across 111 countries
